visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright shot of yellow ginkgo trees in an urban park; a title overlay appears in the center. (2) Transition to an indoor room where a baby in a red hat crawls on the floor while a man and a woman (RU-chan) smile and take a selfie with a smartphone. (3) Scene cuts to the exterior of a 'Matsumoto Kiyoshi' drugstore in Harajuku, with crowds of people walking by under bright daylight. (4) RU-chan is inside the store, wearing a fuzzy grey sweater and holding a yellow shopping basket, gesturing excitedly to the camera. (5) Close-up shots of Rohto Lycee eye drop boxes (Rich Premium and Glow) displayed on a retail shelf. (6) RU-chan holds the pink Lycee bottle, demonstrating how to apply drops to her eyes while pointing at her lower eyelid; she keeps her head relatively level. (7) A close-up shows the specialized nozzle of the Lycee Glow bottle dripping a single drop onto her hand to show precision. (8) Lifestyle shot shows the eye drop bottle being tucked into a yellow Pokémon-themed makeup bag. (9) Transition to RU-chan holding a clear square bottle of 'Meme' eye drops in a cafe-like setting with soft indoor lighting. (10) Close-up of the Melano CC Premium Mask packaging; RU-chan is then seen wearing the white sheet mask on her face, adjusting it with her hands. (11) A sequence shows her squeezing milky essence from a smaller mask pack onto her hand, demonstrating the high liquid content. (12) RU-chan holds a green pack of Okuchi mouthwash strips; she tears one open and demonstrates rinsing her mouth, puffing out her cheeks. (13) She puts the mouthwash packets into a fluffy teddy bear pouch. (14) The video ends with a shot of the man and baby interacting with a mirror-walled structure in a playroom.
